snippet.title: Eldor'idle Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Eldor'idle is a deceptivaly simple incremental idle RPG. Seeking a fortune, you've come to the quaint town of Eldor'idle, where citizens sit around in their houses all day. The house have pots. The pots have coins. Click on a pot and get one coin. You see where this is going.

Wishlist now on Steam!
